owner: Astra scientific direction; root sole execution; Sol implementation
purpose: Distinguish weak finite C31 value fitting from observed feature/target limitations on frozen saved data; not a speed claim or robot authorization.

requirements: Validate finite rows, unique (cycle_index,macro_index), contiguous complete cycles, direction +/-1, macro index consistent with observation54[5]*3, four-leg onehot valid.
Audit direction x macro to leg mapping; grouping remains direction x macro.
No row shuffle, data augmentation, filtering, new scaling or target clipping.

splits.fit_scope: train only; validation and test reporting only; no refit or selection

saved_gae.verify: delta=reward+next_old_value-old_value; gae=delta+(.95**duration_s)*next_gae; value_target=old_value+gae; terminal next values and gae zero

mc_gamma1.definition: Reverse cumulative sum of saved reward within each complete cycle. Gamma=1; no bootstrap; terminal reward already includes saved terminal adjustment.

P.design: 8 direction x macro training-cell means per target

L0.objective: mean squared training residual; minimum-norm OLS

H1.design: [8 direction x macro onehot intercepts, original normalized54[6:54]]

linear_solver: numpy.linalg.lstsq with two RHS targets and rcond=1e-12; ridge augmented X has sqrt(n_train*0.01) times penalty mask, augmented Y zero. Exactly one call per L0/L1/H1. No extra SVD, fits or sweep.

saved_final_value.evaluate: numpy affine formula on original 256 normalized54 rows exactly once; the same 256 predictions are compared to both targets; no torch/checkpoint imports
saved_final_value.training_overlap: Final C31 value trained on all 64 cycles. Its validation/test labels here are diagnostic partition labels, not unseen value validation.

numerics: lstsq returned rank and singular values; retained condition number where defined
nonfinite or degenerate variance yields explicit undefined, never misleading zero
metrics.predictions: Archive all 256 rows with keys/split, both targets, 8 fitted predictions and 1 saved-final value prediction.

interpretation.adequate_descriptive_fit: EV>=0.8 AND MSE_over_P<=0.5 separately on validation and test. Assess each target separately; this fixed reporting label does not select a model or authorize further fitting.
limits: Chronological deterministic data with changing collection policy is not an independent generalization experiment.
OLS train fit diagnoses empirical representability only; ill-conditioning and out-of-time failures remain distinct from optimizer failure.
H1 may reveal useful phase conditioning but cannot prove causality or universal feature inadequacy.
No fitting result establishes physical speed benefit. C31 measured 0.10%-0.41% over fixed and failed its speed gates.

preconditions: Contract frozen and source hashes reviewed by Astra.
Root pure checks completed before Astra source GO.
execution.outputs: New exclusive continuation32/diagnostic_01 only; preserve all previous artifacts.
execution.stop: Any failed input invariant, nonfinite fit, source/input hash change, budget overrun or 300s timeout stops this single attempt. No automatic retry.
forbidden: Import project robot/policy modules or torch.
Run physics, actor/B22/value network code, training, optimizer or checkpoint loading.
Change C31/C30 records, 77 frozen controls, B22 or deployed controller.
Use test/validation rows to fit/select anything.

next_step_boundary: Astra interprets saved result and proposes a separate finite body-shift/recenter timing feasibility contract. No physical or learned speed qualification is granted here.
